identity._match: reported through the BMC rather than DMI, which carries no type 39 record on this machine

instruments._why_both: the difference is supply efficiency, near 82% here, and it degrades before regulation does — so a widening gap is a supply telling you it is tiring.

measured._correction: a declared package-to-wall multiplier of 2.0 predicted about 28 W. The real ratio is 4.5-9x and is not a constant, which is the argument against declaring it at all. Every energy, cost and carbon figure produced before this was measured was understated by roughly that much.
